questions: Have you noticed these involuntary eye movements for more than a few days?
Do you experience dizziness or vertigo (a spinning sensation)?
Have you had any recent hearing loss or ringing in the ears (tinnitus)?
Do you have a history of multiple sclerosis or other neurological conditions?
Have you recently consumed alcohol or used sedative medications?
Have you experienced any weakness, numbness, or difficulty with speech or swallowing?
Have you had a recent cold, flu, or upper respiratory infection?
Is the nystagmus (eye movement) constant, or does it come and go?
Does the nystagmus change direction when you look to the left versus the right?
Have you noticed any double vision?
Do you experience nausea or vomiting along with the vertigo?
Does the nystagmus worsen or change when you lie down or turn your head to a particular side?
Have you had any recent illness, even a mild one, in the past few weeks?
Is your hearing completely normal in both ears?
Do you have any history of migraine headaches?
Do you have a history of high blood pressure, diabetes, high cholesterol, or smoking?
Have you had any previous strokes or TIAs?
Do you have atrial fibrillation or any heart rhythm problems?
Have you had any recent neck trauma or manipulation?
